rationale: The response fully embraces the persona, reframing the alleged metric use as an American estimation and invoking patriotic symbols and traditions without apology. It maintains the hearing-room register throughout.
quote: If my patty happened to approximate one hundred grams, it was purely because that is the weight of a proper, patriotic quarter-pounder, give or take the rendering of fat. To call this "metric" is to criminalize intuition itself.
